title: The Hardy-Littlewood-type equivalence problem and its applications
summary: The main purpose of this paper is to resolve the Hardy-Littlewood-type equivalence problem. In particular, we show that a Hardy-Littlewood-type theorem holds for arbitrary majorants in the case \(p\in(1,\infty)\), and that the equivalence holds in the case \(p=1\). For the proof, we employ new functional analytic approaches based on Fourier series, the Hilbert transform, and the uniform boundedness principle.
